result.summary: Graph 00001 is nontraceable: a sign-defined 20-vertex cut leaves 22 components, violating the spanning-path bound 21. The same structure proves alpha=22 and a perfect matching. Core ear endpoints all lie in one bipartition class.

methods: independently generate and compare all 44 proper listed states and 74 legal edges
verify each outside P10 equals a constant C15 with five consecutive states deleted
verify the 24-state core bipartition and all four terminal signs
verify the full 24/20 sign partition and exactly two same-sign edges
check an explicit 22-edge perfect matching and independent set of size22
limitations: the certificate concerns the fixed boundary 00001 graph
